entries.name: Zillian
entries.description: A wanderer carrying a power with a price — a shadow that drinks blood. He carries no title, but something worse...

sections.heading: Biography
sections.content: Zillian is the protagonist of Shadow Covenant. He bears the curse of the Shadow Tiger and must balance its hunger against his humanity.

blocks.content: Zillian is the protagonist of Shadow Covenant. He bears the curse of the Shadow Tiger and must balance its hunger against his humanity.

sections.heading: Powers
sections.content: Shadow Tiger — a massive shadow beast summoned through blood sacrifice. His power is linked to the shadow domain, one that requires a heavy toll.

entries.name: Garret
entries.description: An elder of the village of Halwen, carrying the weight of a cursed covenant.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.content: Garret is the pragmatic leader of Halwen. He orchestrated the deal with Baron Doren to protect the village from the corrupt god Voryn, even if it meant paying a heavy price.

entries.name: Sera
entries.description: A masked elven woman with an inhuman efficiency in combat, investigating the ruined networks of ancient mages.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.content: Sera arrives in Halwen just before the raid. She understands the geometry of combat and magic. She is tracing the path of Erica, the mage who built the god-tethers.

entries.name: Voryn
entries.description: A vast 30-meter corrupted wolf-god, cracked with leaking divine energy, unable to distinguish friend from foe.

sections.heading: History
sections.content: Voryn was once the protector of the valley. Driven mad and failing, the mage Erica attempted to heal him via an underground tether.

entries.name: Furu Saltfurr
entries.description: The legendary founder of Saltstead and the Saltfurr Clans.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.content: Gfuru led the Tabaxi away from the mainland conflicts to establish a neutral port in the Crystal Waters. His vision was a haven for outcasts and merchants alike.

sections.heading: Legacy
sections.content: His name is invoked in every major treaty signed in Saltstead. The clan he founded remains the dominant political force in the region.

entries.name: Tora Saltfurr
entries.description: Daughter of Gfuru and the current Port Master of Saltstead.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.content: Tora is known for her shrewd business acumen and her refusal to bend to mainland political pressure. She maintains the neutrality her father established.

entries.name: Saltfurr Clans
entries.description: The dominant political and economic force in the Crystal Waters, originally formed by Tabaxi refugees.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: The Saltfurr Clans operate as a loose syndicate of merchant families. They control the shipyards, the tariff offices, and the primary trade routes running through the archipelago.

sections.heading: Culture
sections.content: A culture built on debt, favor, and contract. A Saltfurr promise is considered more binding than steel.

entries.name: Tabaxi
entries.description: A feline humanoid race known for their agility, curiosity, and merchant skills.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: Originally from the deep southern jungles of the mainland, the Tabaxi were largely displaced during the early expansion wars. Many took to the seas, becoming exceptional navigators.

sections.heading: Culture
sections.content: They value stories and unique experiences over pure gold, though they are certainly not opposed to accumulating wealth.

entries.name: Saltstead
entries.description: A thriving neutral port city built on a series of interconnected atolls.

sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Saltstead is a marvel of maritime engineering. The city is a maze of wooden boardwalks, floating docks, and stone foundations built directly into the coral reefs.

sections.heading: Economy
sections.content: Driven almost entirely by maritime trade, tariffs, and ship repair.

entries.name: Crystal Waters
entries.description: A massive archipelago known for its unnaturally clear waters and treacherous submerged reefs.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: The waters are so clear that the seabed is often visible at depths of fifty feet. Navigating the reefs requires specialized local pilots.

entries.name: Aegir Ocean
entries.description: The largest body of water in the known world.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: The Aegir separates the western continents from the unknown east. It is home to massive sea beasts and unpredictable magical storms.

entries.name: Thibis
entries.description: A powerful militaristic city-state on the mainland coast.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: Thibis is known for its rigid caste system and its aggressive expansionist policies, which originally drove the Tabaxi to flee to the Crystal Waters.

entries.name: Halwen
entries.description: A secluded village in a valley that 'breathes wrong'.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: Halwen was secretly subjected to a protection racket managed by Baron Doren, using a corrupted god as leverage.

entries.name: Solvara
entries.description: A diverse region on the continent of Arcaelis.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: The setting for much of the early conflicts in Zephyr.

entries.name: War of the Red Waters
entries.description: A brutal three-year naval conflict between the Saltfurr Clans and the Thibis Armada.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: Thibis attempted to annex Saltstead to control the archipelago's trade routes. The Tabaxi, using their superior knowledge of the reefs and light, maneuverable catamarans, lured the heavy Thibian galleons into the shallow coral mazes. The resulting slaughter gave the war its name.

entries.name: Craben Lurker
entries.description: A massive, heavily armored crustacean that hunts in the twilight zones of the reef drop-offs.

sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Growing up to twenty feet across, they remain motionless for weeks, disguised as coral outcroppings, before striking with claws capable of snapping a mainmast in half.

world.name: Zephyr
world.description: Three dominions shape the known world. Magic, Aura, and Primal Essence form the foundation of power across the continents.

continents.name: Arcaelis
continents.title: The Mana Dominion
continents.description: A continent deeply developed with ancient ruins, high magic, and diverse races including Elves, Dwarves, and Necromancers.

continents.name: Valkryn
continents.title: The Aura Dominion
continents.description: A harsh continent ruled by strength, sects, and martial prowess.

continents.name: Thrynthal
continents.title: The Primal Wilds
continents.description: An untamed land of beastmen, shapeshifters, and pure instinctual energy.

energies.name: Mana
energies.description: The energy of the mind and arcane shaping.

energies.name: Aura
energies.description: The energy of the body and martial might.

energies.name: Primal Essence
energies.description: The chaotic, powerful energy of the wild.
